text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick update — rolling out a small set of travel + PTO policy changes today. TL;DR: 1) ExpenseBot will auto-attach receipts for corporate card charges; 2) streamlined international travel pre-approval window (submit 10 business days before departure); 3) temporary PTO advisory for the EMEA product launch (May 12–15) — exceptions handled case-by-case; 4) compassionate leave top-up: +3 days for qualifying events; 5) friendly reminder about vendor/event code-of-conduct guidelines. Full details + form links: https://intranet.redwood/people/travel-pto-2026 (please read if you travel or had PTO planned). :megaphone:

Jules (People Ops): Short clarifications — the EMEA blackout is an advisory targeted at roles tagged as "launch-critical" in the launch roster. If you're not on the roster, treat it as a heads-up but you're not blocked from requesting PTO.

Sam (Finance): About receipts — ExpenseBot will auto-attach receipts for charges on the Redwood corporate cards and for bookings made through our Travel Portal. If you paid with a personal card, you'll still need to upload the receipt within 30 days or expense will be flagged. Ping me if your card receipts aren't showing up.

Alex (Engineer): I have a pre-approved family trip May 13–14 that was approved last month. Does that get grandfathered?

Maya (People Ops): Yes — if your manager approved PTO before today, it’s grandfathered. Please DM me or @Jules with the approval screenshot so we can mark it as exception.

Tess (Manager): Will this advisory apply to APAC folks or just EMEA?

Jules (People Ops): Primarily EMEA for the May launch (timing & oncall overlap). APAC teams aren't subject to the blackout but as always coordinate with your manager to ensure coverage during launches.

Alex (Engineer): Thanks. One more: what counts as a "qualifying event" for the +3 compassionate days?

Lina (People Ops): Good Q — qualifying events include immediate family serious illness, bereavement, and major caregiving emergencies. We have a short form to request the top-up and it goes to People Ops for quick review; no need to share medical details in Slack. Link in the policy doc.

ExpenseBot: Expense auto-attach enabled for Redwood Corporate Cards as of 2026-05-01. Commands: `/expense status` `/expense help` `/expense attach <txid>` — see https://intranet.redwood/expensebot for troubleshooting.

Sam (Finance): Note: if ExpenseBot mis-matches a receipt, you can force-attach by uploading and referencing the transaction id (visible in the expense modal). We will monitor the first two weeks and open a small ops channel for reports.

Maya (People Ops): We'll be hosting a 30-min office hours tomorrow 10:30 PT to walk through the changes and answer exceptions. Invite will go out. If you already have travel or PTO planned in that window, flag it now so we can track exceptions. :calendar:

Tess (Manager): Appreciate the heads-up. Will share the info in my team's channel.

Alex (Engineer): Thanks, will DM Maya my approval screenshot.

Jules (People Ops): If anyone's unsure whether their role is 'launch-critical', check the roster here: https://intranet.redwood/launch-roster or ask your manager.

Maya (People Ops): Final note — vendor events: please follow the updated Code of Conduct section in the doc; vendors must be registered in advance and any sponsor swag distribution needs clearance. We had a small compliance question last month so tightening the process.

Sam (Finance): Reimbursements timeline unchanged (30 days). Any exceptions tied to the compassionate leave top-up will be reviewed case-by-case.

Lina (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Posting this to the People Ops pinned updates after office hours so it’s easy to find. :pushpin:
